name: Canary Islands
summary: A vertical tricolour of white, blue and yellow. The official version adds the arms with seven islands and two dogs.
origin: The colours come from the provinces of Santa Cruz de Tenerife (white and blue) and Las Palmas (blue and yellow). The flag was adopted in the 1982 Statute of Autonomy.

colors.name: Blue
colors.meaning: The sea; shared by both provinces.

facts: The islands' name comes from the Latin 'canis', dog, not from canaries.
The nationalist flag adds seven green stars.
clues: White, blue and yellow vertical bands.
Its islands are named after dogs, not birds.
